facts.raw_span: pruritic, pink scaling plaques on her face and neck
lesions subsequently involved her chest, abdomen, and back and flared with sun exposure
Well-demarcated plaques with an overlying scale crust occurring in a photodistributed pattern on the central face, with involvement of chest, abdomen, and back
Antinuclear antibody titers positive at 1:640
Lymphopenia present
Normocytic anemia present
Epidermal acanthosis, spongiosis, and acantholytic keratinocytes
Dense lymphoplasmacellular infiltrate in the dermis, with scattered neutrophils and eosinophils
Granular and linear deposition of IgG and C3 at the basement membrane zone and abundant intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 in the upper two-thirds of the epidermis
Negative or within normal limits: antiribonucleoprotein, antihistone, antiphospholipid, anti-Smith, anti-Ro/Sjögren syndrome antigen A, and anti-La/Sjögren syndrome antigen B antibodies
Normal C3, C4, CH50, rapid plasma reagin, and creatinine levels
Normal erythrocyte sedimentation rate
